summary: Flat residential kerb with parked cars; homes within 25 m all round.
reasons: Houses lining both sides within 25 m

drivers.seclusion: Dense houses on both sides; south-side homes roughly 11-25 m from the kerb, north homes across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Ordinary two-way street with cars parked along the kerb, so a van can pull in.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; a junction at each end.
drivers.convention: Several cars park on the street, so a van will not look out of place.

flags: Steep at the east end: about 7% to the junction
sun_shade: Mostly open, with street trees and house shade from the south.
cannot_judge: Exact building distances at this section

best_section.where: Payne Street south kerb, mid-block between the two cross-streets
